# Vendored haystackeditor/pixijs dist

This directory contains the built `dist/` output from Haystack's custom pixi.js fork.

- Source: https://github.com/haystackeditor/pixijs
- Commit: `11a1a9d5a741ef3563321514ac7d925bb9bbc165`
- Package: `pixi.js@8.1.6`
- Built with: Node.js `20.14.0`, `npm ci`, `npm run build`

`build-scripts/edit-npm-modules.sh` copies this directory into `node_modules/pixi.js/dist` after `yarn` installs dependencies.
